name: Authentication Service
description: Manages JWT tokens, SSO session lifecycle, and OAuth credentials for internal microservices.

name: User Service
description: Handles user profile identities, role-based access control, and user profile sync.

name: Order Management Service
description: Coordinates checkout pipelines, shopping cart processing, and stateful order workflows.

name: Payment Gateway Service
description: Interfaces with merchant payment gateways for card transactions, payouts, and refund handshakes.

name: Notification Service
description: Dispatches asynchronous transactional email receipts, SMS OTP alerts, and webhook notifications.

name: Inventory Service
description: Tracks warehouse inventory levels, SKU allocations, warehouse bin locations, and restock locks.
